name: Supply Core

repository.note: The public repository. Grok clones it only to read SUPPLY_CORE_BOOTSTRAP.md and these files. It never runs Supply Core from the clone.

integrations.name: Supply Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the service. The host types the invite code from Saad on the page and picks Supply Core. Grok cannot approve itself.

integrations.name: Grok shopping and Vault
integrations.auth: The host's own Grok shopping tools and Vault. Saved cards, Shop Pay, Link, and X Money stay in the host's Vault. Supply Core never sees them.

routines.name: Supply Core Check
routines.schedule: Daily at the check time the host picked (10:00 unless they chose another).

neverIncluded: card numbers, expiry dates, or security codes
Vault contents: saved cards, Shop Pay, Link, or X Money
order numbers or live order records
Supply Core connector or OAuth tokens
addresses or phone numbers from a real setup
